sections.overview:
Duration: 1 January 2024 – 31 December 2026

This engagement provides continuous delivery, enhancement, and production support for Freeport-McMoRan's Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and Business Intelligence ecosystem. The team ensures reliable data integration, reporting, and analytics services that support mining operations, maintenance, logistics, finance, and executive decision-making. The engagement also focuses on system stability, issue resolution, performance optimization, and delivering new business reporting capabilities through an agile delivery model.

sections.overview:
Duration: 10 October 2024 – 31 July 2026

The T4V initiative focuses on modernizing enterprise reporting by rewiring and repointing existing data pipelines, reports, and dashboards from legacy platforms to SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, and cloud-based reporting solutions. The engagement ensures seamless data migration, report validation, and minimal business disruption while improving data quality, reporting performance, and long-term maintainability. This transformation enables mining business users to access accurate and consistent operational, HR, and financial information from a unified enterprise platform.
